song.title: Always With Me, Always With You

guitar.evidence: Joe Satriani's Ibanez JS signature series is extremely well documented, one of the longest-running guitarist signature lines in the industry.

tone.target: singing sustain lead with delay and light chorus sheen
tone.profile: singing sustain lead with delay and light chorus sheen
tone.summary: A smooth, highly sustained clean/edge-of-breakup tone using a classic combo amp model, enhanced by chorus and digital delay for atmospheric depth.
corrections: use smooth lead sustain, not clean-only
keep delay subtle under the melody

rig.name: Joe Satriani - Always With Me, Always With You - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Gentle boost to enhance sustain and lead presence.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for subtle lift rather than a dedicated compressor, as per 'avoid overly compressed sound'.

alternatives.reason: A compressor would provide more sustain but might violate the 'overly compressed' avoidance.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle grit and edge-of-breakup sustain without heavy dirt.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is used lightly to simulate the 'smooth high-gain combo' feel, avoiding full distortion.

alternatives.reason: Might be too aggressive for a clean arpeggio foundation.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a classic clean/crunch combo amp tone (Satch-style).
Tight, articulate sound suitable for lead work and arpeggios.
Add the required 'light chorus sheen' and width to the lead tone.
Provide subtle delay for atmospheric depth and vibrato lead phrasing.
Add subtle space and sustain without muddying the clean tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better articulation and depth.

proposals.reason: Enhance the natural, open sound of Satch's clean lead tone.
